question: What is inside this permission set group, and has it finished recalculating?

steps.name: grp
steps.soql: SELECT Id, DeveloperName, MasterLabel, Status, CreatedBy.Name, CreatedDate, LastModifiedBy.Name, LastModifiedDate FROM PermissionSetGroup WHERE DeveloperName = '{group}'

steps.name: components
steps.soql: SELECT PermissionSet.Name, PermissionSet.Label FROM PermissionSetGroupComponent WHERE PermissionSetGroup.DeveloperName = '{group}' ORDER BY PermissionSet.Name

verdicts.say: {group} status is {= grp.records[0].Status}: grants are not final until it reads Updated.
{group} holds {components.rows} permission set(s) and is up to date.

traps: A muting permission set in the group removes grants; it appears here as a component.
